title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established international business based in Aylesbury.
Reporting to the number one of Finance , you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, banking and month-end.
This is a varied, hands-on position where no two days will be exactly the same.
Your new role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and intercompany accounts
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining accurate account records
- Processing expenses and supporting accruals and prepayments
- Issuing customer statements and following up outstanding balances
- Resolving customer payment and pricing queries
- Raising invoices and credit notes
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Reconciling retail sales, card payments, settlements and associated fees
- Supporting month-end reporting and audit requirements
- Assisting the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects and process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You'll be an experienced finance professional with a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach and a genuine problem-solving mindset.
Ideally, you'll have worked in a similar hands-on finance role, with the confidence to investigate discrepancies, resolve complex queries and see issues through to completion.You'll ideally bring:
- Experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and account reconciliations
- Experience investigating and resolving complex financial queries
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, analytical and problem-solving approach
- Good Excel skills and previous experience using accounting software
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider team

An AAT qualification or equivalent would be beneficial but is not essential.
You'll also have an interest in developing your systems knowledge and embracing new technology, including the appropriate use of AI tools to support financial processes and improve efficiency.
What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a role that offers more variety and responsibility than a traditional transactional finance position.You'll gain exposure across several areas of the finance function while working closely with the Finance Manager within an established international business.The package includes:
- £35,000-£38,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Hybrid working two days per week from home
- Flexible working around standard hours of 9am-5pm

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact us directly for further information.

title: Administrator
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Administrator to join our growing team in Aylesbury. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator with strong data entry, document control, and Microsoft Office skills to support the smooth day-to-day operation of a busy project environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing project documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring information is logged, tracked, and distributed efficiently. A keen eye for detail and strong Excel skills are essential for this position.

The position is for three months with a view to offer long term work.

Monday to Friday 8am 5pm

Key Responsibilities
- Perform accurate data entry and maintain project databases and records.
- Manage document control processes, including issuing, filing, tracking, and archiving documents.
- Ensure all project documentation is up-to-date, correctly formatted, and stored in accordance with company procedures.
- Maintain spreadsheets and reports using Microsoft Excel.
- Monitor document revisions and maintain document registers.
- Support project teams with administrative tasks and document requests.
- Manage incoming and outgoing documentation from clients, suppliers, and project stakeholders.

title: Administrator
description:
SF Partners are supporting a brilliant business in Aylesbury who are looking to recruit an Office Administrator on a permanent basis.

Hours: full time site based Monday to Friday
Salary: up to £30,000

The post holder will work closely with the Commercial Operations and Marketing Manager and will be expected to liaise professionally with internal teams, visitors, customers, suppliers and subcontractors.
Day-to-day priorities will be agreed with the line manager, with the post holder expected to manage routine administrative tasks independently once trained.

Key Responsibilities:
-Provide general administrative support to the Commercial team, including preparing and formatting standard business documents, data entry, maintaining records, updating trackers and routine office coordination.
-Carry out reception duties, including welcoming visitors, answering calls, managing enquiries and processing incoming and outgoing post.
-Maintain office supplies, filing systems and administrative records.
-Coordinate meetings and business travel, including room bookings, agendas, meeting packs, accommodation, itineraries, refreshments and expense administration.
-Provide administrative support for marketing and exhibition activities, including coordinating promotional materials, maintaining marketing stock, and assisting with event logistics
-Handle confidential information appropriately and comply with company policies and procedures, including health and safety requirements.
-Provide administrative support to the Commercial Operations & Marketing Manager, undertaking additional routine administrative tasks as required within the scope of the Office/Admin Assistant role.

Key results areas:
-Visitors, telephone calls and enquiries are handled promptly and professionally.
-Reception, post, office supplies and shared office areas are maintained to a high standard.
-Administrative support for meetings, travel and marketing activities is delivered accurately and within agreed timescales.
-Company procedures, including confidentiality and health and safety requirements, are followed consistently.

title: Project Co-ordinator
description:
Job Title: Project Co-Ordinator

Location: Aylesbury, Office based

Contract Details: Full Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday to Friday, alternating weekly shifts - 8:30am to 4:30pm and 9:00am to 5:00pm (1 hour lunch break)

Salary: 28,000 per annum

Holiday entitlement: 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Responsibilities:
- Manage customer enquiries from initial enquiry through to project completion
- Coordinate surveys, quotations, and ongoing project activities
- Raise job packs, maintain project files, and update job scheduling information
- Liaise with engineering, purchasing, and operational teams to ensure projects are delivered efficiently
- Produce quotations, costings, calculations, and completion reports
- Ensure completed projects are processed for invoicing
- Respond to customer queries and complaints, resolving issues where possible
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records
- Ensure all work is completed in line with company quality assurance procedures

Skills and Attributes:
- Previous customer service or customer support experience
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
- Excellent organisational and project coordination abilities
- Strong attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
- Team player with a flexible and positive approach
- Customer-focused mindset
- Ability to understand and discuss basic technical information
- Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

Desirable Skills:
- Experience coordinating projects, jobs, or service activities
- Experience working within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, facilities management, or technical environment
- Experience handling quotations, reports, or scheduling activities

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy seeing projects through from enquiry to completion, this could be the role for you! Please apply via this job site or reach out directly to Adecco Aylesbury.
